name: Techno (peak-time)
description: Rumbling kick + sub, sparse hypnotic mids, crisp hats. Big room, tight mono low end.
notes: Kick and its rumble own 40-100 Hz; little else lives there.
Mids kept sparse so the loop stays hypnotic; percussion sits 2-8 kHz.
Club master: around -8 LUFS, mono below 120 Hz.
source: hand-tuned estimate from genre conventions (not measured from a track corpus)
